mapper.sql: select m.media_id, m.baby_id, m.file_name, m.object_key, m.mime_type, m.file_size, m.media_type, m.tag_code, m.description, m.health_check_id, m.uploader_id, m.uploader_name, m.del_flag, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, h.check_date as health_check_date from nc_media m left join nc_health_check h on h.check_id = m.health_check_id
mapper.insert: insert into nc_media ( baby_id, file_name, object_key, mime_type, file_size, media_type, tag_code, description, health_check_id, uploader_id, uploader_name, del_flag, create_time ) values ( #{babyId}, #{fileName}, #{objectKey}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{mediaType}, #{tagCode}, #{description}, #{healthCheckId}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderName}, #{delFlag}, current_timestamp )
mapper.update: update nc_media set tag_code = #{tagCode}, description = #{description}, health_check_id = #{healthCheckId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp where media_id = #{mediaId} and del_flag = '0'
update nc_media set del_flag = '2', update_time = current_timestamp where media_id = #{mediaId} and del_flag = '0'
